title: Archive scoped negative native Fraction score-dispatch probe
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Retain the completed native Fraction score-dispatch probe as a focused, scoped negative finding. Its fixed B,C,C,B micro passes 33 prefix comparisons and ten functional/source controls, and both paired differences improve. The smaller pair illustrates only 0.187221 wall / 0.187228 CPU seconds when scaled to the frozen score-addition count. This falls below the parent complete candidate's observed ranges of 0.460568 wall / 0.45 CPU seconds, even with zero added validation cost. The prescribed conservative screen stops expansion.

This is an engineering screen for this probe. It establishes no complete saving, universal obstruction, new construction or kappa gain. No full control union, actual audit, complete caller or complete candidate was built. The validated performance contribution in [PR #5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) remains frozen and unchanged. Archive retention does not imply scientific approval or admission.

## Task and overlap

Task replay-runtime, refined scope PR5864/native-score-dispatch-micro-only; canonical main de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a, priority revision 8. Parent [PR #5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) head: 3f15c943e4ad6479f03e674c80fff1269a16ccfe. The original fork artifact was 781440db2533bcfb6803d519ff5d71088861cb48, already released in this [seven-field finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864#issuecomment-6439141466). The donor now requests upstream retention.

This publication isolates the 52-file package from its parent implementation. All 50 scientific, probe, evidence, notice and other package files are byte-identical to that original artifact. Only TASK.json's base and SOURCES.json's publication pins change. The complete immutable 163-file parent export remains a vendored input, authenticated at its exact head and SHA256. The new five-input ancestor is dec843d2aebd0e66f2767aaac26d3db3f32a7226; the publication head is 3ed05e3ebf48c0ea507b9819dad30898942d4ca8. Historical source pins and raw receipts remain intact.

Nearest work: [PR #5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) supplies the measured native cache/loop parent; [PR #5852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5852) and [PR #5853](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5853) retain earlier Fraction table and zero/unit feasibility findings; [PR #5848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5848) supplies the frozen qualifier. This adds the later, explicitly rejected score-dispatch probe. Fresh targeted upstream searches for its original branch and package path found no matching PR; coverage is bounded and unpublished overlap is not excluded. Live canonical main is unchanged at the pin above.

The branch starts from 01014cbe772ea5a59ccbc55266222433944c7368, retaining Ali Romman's exact test-only [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) repair, original ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a. Its authorship is preserved; it is an inherited dependency, not new work here. Relative to that repair, this PR adds only the 52 package files and does not duplicate [PR #5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864)'s implementation.

## Validation

Historical evidence retains the one cold native B,C,C,B probe, every sample, 33 prefix comparisons, ten controls and the subsequent conservative stop. Counter asymmetry is documented: the direct arm pays per-add dispatch counters while the generic arm reports its aggregate at exit. The illustrative scaling is not a bound on actual saving. No timing permutation or sample omission followed the stop.

Registered reproduction:

    python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fraction-native-score-dispatch-feasibility

Registered replay freshly compiles the probe and checks complete prefix values/types/branches, generic custom/subtype fallback, nonexact increments, direct exceptions without retry, partial update order, callback mutation, invalid packets, binding drift and runtime restoration. Linux CPython 3.12, existing cc and Python development headers are required; there is no install or silent native skip. Registered replay does not repeat timings.

Publication preparation passes metadata/source pins, all 52 committed bytes and modes, and export coverage for all five declared inputs. Fresh finite replay passes normally, under optimization and from a Git-free read-only export, each within one second on CPython 3.12.3 / GCC 13.3. Commands were serial, bounded by 180 seconds / 1 GiB sampled group RSS / 600 seconds initial aggregate / no automatic retry, with no stderr and unchanged source bytes/modes. No full benchmark or historical actual replay was repeated. Full-history source preflight remains unavailable in the shallow checkout; no such pass is claimed. Hosted exact-head CI will be reported separately.

The original source-authentication harness failure is retained: compiling an isolated function altered imported-module call opcodes; complete-module authentication preserves context. The failed draft and receipts remain. The original publication setup failure is retained in the raw evidence; this isolated publication also encountered and resolved a sparse-index staging setup rejection before committing, with no scientific rerun or data change. These are packaging/harness events, not failed mathematical differentials silently repaired.

The parent 964 comparisons / 118 controls and complete qualification were not repeated for this rejected extension. Full-control integration, the planned prior dispatch controls, new Cache/Event lifetime integration, actual audit, complete performance qualification, independent human/proof-kernel acceptance and physical supplier admission remain unclaimed.

## Credit

Original Fraction/error arithmetic and independent integer backend: Ali Romman. Preserve Adam Gall, ywz65 / [PR #2878](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2878), Mason Hale / [PR #5811](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5811), [PR #5831](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5831), [PR #5826](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5826), [PR #5819](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5819), and all nested P104/native/compiler/precision notices. Tooling lineage includes [PR #5839](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5839), [PR #5816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5816), [PR #5818](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5818), [PR #5832](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5832), [PR #5848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5848), [PR #5852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5852), [PR #5853](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5853), [PR #5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) and Ali Romman's exact [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) repair.

New probe and recorded execution: Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. GPT-6-astra xhigh performed static nomination/stop review only, with no compiler or numerical work. This publication audit uses a donor-requested agent. Standard dispatch/C API techniques; Apache-2.0 and original notices retained.

## Open next questions

None justified for further measured continuation in this round. A separately proposed mechanism needs its own source, ownership, coverage and complete-cost argument before a new fixed feasibility gate. Constructor-elision and descriptor-metadata ideas retain unpriced obligations; this stop does not exclude them. See the package README and TASK.json. This archival publication dispatches no successor experiment. Kappa research, Work 1/2, feeds and automations remain paused.
